io.milvus.v2.utils

Class VectorUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.utils.VectorUtils

  • public class VectorUtils
extends Object
    Utility class used internally by the Milvus Java SDK v2 to convert query, search, and hybrid search requests into the gRPC protobuf requests sent to the Milvus server.

    Also provides helpers for building filter expression templates and primary key filter expressions.

      • ConvertToGrpcQueryRequest

        public QueryRequest ConvertToGrpcQueryRequest(QueryReq request)
        Converts an SDK v2 QueryReq into a gRPC QueryRequest.

        Maps the filter expression, partition names, output fields, consistency level, query parameters, offset, limit, and timezone onto the gRPC request.

        Parameters:
        request - the SDK v2 query request
        Returns:
        the gRPC query request
        Throws:
        NullPointerException - if request is null

      • ConvertToGrpcSearchRequest

        public SearchRequest ConvertToGrpcSearchRequest(SearchReq request)
        Converts an SDK v2 SearchReq into a gRPC SearchRequest.

        Maps the search targets (vectors or IDs), filter expression, search parameters, output fields, consistency level, ranker/function score, function chains, and highlighter onto the gRPC request.

        Parameters:
        request - the SDK v2 search request
        Returns:
        the gRPC search request

      • deduceAndCreateTemplateValue

        public static TemplateValue deduceAndCreateTemplateValue(Object value)
        Deduces the gRPC template value type from a Java value and creates the corresponding TemplateValue.

        Supported types are Boolean, Integer/Long, Double, String, byte[], and List. Lists are converted recursively into template array values.

        Parameters:
        value - the value used as a filter expression template parameter
        Returns:
        the gRPC template value
        Throws:
        MilvusClientException - if the value type is not supported

      • convertAnnSearchParam

        public static SearchRequest convertAnnSearchParam(AnnSearchReq annSearchReq,
                                                  ConsistencyLevel consistencyLevel)
        Converts an AnnSearchReq into a gRPC SearchRequest.

        Maps the target vectors, search parameters, filter expression, and consistency level onto the gRPC request.

        Parameters:
        annSearchReq - the ANN search request
        consistencyLevel - the consistency level to apply, may be null
        Returns:
        the gRPC search request
        Throws:
        NullPointerException - if annSearchReq is null

      • ConvertToGrpcHybridSearchRequest

        public HybridSearchRequest ConvertToGrpcHybridSearchRequest(HybridSearchReq request)
        Converts an SDK v2 HybridSearchReq into a gRPC HybridSearchRequest.

        Converts each sub-request via convertAnnSearchParam(AnnSearchReq, ConsistencyLevel) and maps the ranker/function score, group-by settings, output fields, and consistency level onto the gRPC request.

        Parameters:
        request - the SDK v2 hybrid search request
        Returns:
        the gRPC hybrid search request
        Throws:
        MilvusClientException - if the sub-request list is empty or both a ranker and a function score are set

      • getExprById

        public String getExprById(String primaryFieldName,
                          List<?> ids)
        Builds a filter expression of the form primaryFieldName in [...] from the given primary key values. String IDs are quoted, other ID types are rendered as-is.
        Parameters:
        primaryFieldName - the primary key field name
        ids - the list of primary key values
        Returns:
        the built filter expression
